title: ValueConsistencyBench: A Benchmark for Measuring Intra-Session Value Coherence in RLHF Models

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: measuring whether RLHF degrades value consistency addresses a form of alignment failure. However, the connection between PVQ-measured value consistency and actual safe behavior is indirect and debatable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Adapting the PVQ-RR to conversation format and running it on model pairs is moderately accessible. Pairwise contradiction detection requires some NLP engineering. Three evaluation conditions multiply the work.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 57-item questionnaire across 3 conditions on multiple model pairs. The PVQ-RR adaptation and contradiction detection pipeline add up, though the questionnaire itself is fixed-length.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
